_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fluid_turbulence#4 and a FALSIFICATION. The entry wrote 'a FLUID_DYNAMIC LES with TURBULENCE_MODEL: Smagorinsky'. There is no TURBULENCE_MODEL key: 4C rejects it as unused input and its candidate list names the real one, PHYSICAL_MODEL. More importantly the model is not one switch but three. On the upstream channel deck f3_cha_8x8x8_recongradl2, PHYSICAL_MODEL: Smagorinsky together with C_SMAGORINSKY: 0.1 but the DEFAULT TURBULENCE_APPROACH (DNS_OR_RESVMM_LES) reproduces the no-model result exactly -- exit 0, zero result-test failures, and no warning that the model was skipped. Only adding TURBULENCE_APPROACH: CLASSICAL_LES makes the eddy viscosity bite, at which point both pinned velocities shift. C_SMAGORINSKY itself defaults to 0, so it is a third way to get a silent no-op. The entry's separate point about averaging windows is governed by SAMPLING_START / SAMPLING_STOP / DUMPING_PERIOD; 'running_mean' is not 4C vocabulary. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the key-name arm: use the real key. The unused-input rejection vanishes, so the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from: sed 's|^FLUID DYNAMIC/TURBULENCE MODEL:|FLUID DYNAMIC/TURBULENCE MODEL:\n  TURBULENCE_MODEL: "Smagorinsky"|' "$BASE" > "$TMP/claimedkey.yaml"

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the silently-inert arm: give it the approach switch too, so it becomes a working LES. HALFON_RESULT_FAILURES stops being 0 and the inertness claim collapses, so the fixture must go red.
remove the discriminating arm: build the full-LES deck without the approach switch, so nothing in the fixture ever changes the answer. FULLON_RESULT_FAILURES drops to 0, so the fixture must go red.
